reviews.title: It does what it's supposed to, but...
reviews.comment: Looks great, and works like it should, but what a pain to install. Keeps my 5700X3D around 65°c while gaming. UPDATE: 05/29/24 Temp display works when it wants to, constantly having to reinstall "driver". Fans are now making a weird ticking noise. But, its still keeping the CPU cool, so its still doing what its supposed too. UPDATE: 05/30/24 Temp display just doesnt work at all now. Uninstalled/Reinstalled driver multiple times. Shows temp in App but not on display.
reviews.author: Mike O'Brien

reviews.title: Inexpensive,  works well
reviews.comment: I bought the cheapest water cooler I could find, to fit an old FX 8 core AM3 + cpu, and put in a case that wasn't really designed for water cooling,  on a motherboard that did have a cpu2 fan header, but water cooling probably was not what they had in mind. Surprise it installed easily,  and dropped the idle cpu temp by 10 degrees! No clue on durability,  but for a watercolor that's 2 to 3 times less then a name brand, it's fairly impressive.
reviews.author: Nick Hammond

reviews.title: Nice product for price but buyer beware!
reviews.comment: I purchased this for Christmas and it does preform well and overall it's a solid simple liquid cooler to plug in and install into your PC. Though I would recommend making sure it will fit with your towers layout and mounting slots. It wasn't a perfect fit for mine but I was able to make it work with what I did have. So I give it a 4 out of five stars for being a decent product that keeps my CPU cool. However the remote that is advertised was not even in my product I purchased. So for lack of fully delivering me the product a bought I cannot give it a higher rating. Hopefully mine was just a dud but I have heard others have missing remotes as well. If the retailer can supply a remote I would give 5 stars.
